docket.docket_text: COMPLAINT against Howard Matasaar, Iman Mohammad Afifiy, D. F. Napoli, Paul Chappius, Jr, Stanley T. Chaplain, D. Walker, James Conner, filed by Alfredo Victoria, Holy Tabernacle Ministries, Jeremiah Stroman.(DLC) (Entered: 07/02/2007)

MOTION for Leave to Proceed in forma pauperis by Alfredo Victoria. Modified on 7/3/2007 (DLC). Modified on 3/20/2008 (DLC). (Additional attachment(s) added on 3/20/2008: # 1 IFP Motion) (DLC). (Entered: 07/02/2007)
MOTION for Leave to Proceed in forma pauperis by Jeremiah Stroman. (Document found in file undocketed.) (DLC) (Entered: 03/19/2008)

ORDER directing written and appropriately detailed responses to certain questions ( see pages 7 and 8 in Order for questions) by no later than September 24, 2007 and directing the Clerk to send plaintiff copies of the complaints in each of the four actions addressed in this Order. Signed by Hon. William M. Skretny on 8/16/07. (JDK) (Entered: 08/17/2007)
Set Deadlines/Hearings: plaintiffs Response to Order, docket No.3 due by 9/24/2007 (JDK) (Entered: 08/17/2007)
Letter in file dated September 17, 2007 from Jeremiah Stroman in response to Order dated August 17, 2007 (received September 19, 2007 and filed today.) (DLC) (Entered: 03/19/2008)

DECISION & ORDER, each plaintiff is required to advise the Court, separately and in writing, whether he wishes for the instant action to proceed, or whether he wishes to withdraw the complaint. In addition, plaintiff Victoria will be required, in writing to confirm whether he in fact signed the complaint. Holy Tabernacle Ministries terminated. ORDERED TO SHOW CAUSE in writing by 5/16/2008. Order and a copy of the their complaints forwarded to each plaintiff. Signed by Hon. David G. Larimer on 4/8/2008. (DLC) (Entered: 04/10/2008)
REPLY/RESPONSE to 6 Order, filed by Alfredo Victoria. (DLC) (Entered: 04/16/2008)

ORDER, because plaintiff Jeremiah Stroman has demonstrated no good cause for his failure to respond to the Court's second Order as to his intent to proceed in this action, plaintiff Stroman is dismissed as a plaintiff to this action without prejudice. Signed by Hon. David G. Larimer on 8/26/2008. (DLC) (Entered: 08/28/2008)

TEXT ORDER denying 4 Motion for Leave to Proceed in forma pauperis as moot by reason of Order 8 . SO ORDERED. Issued by Hon. H. Kenneth Schroeder, Jr. on March 26, 2009. (gioia, allison) (Entered: 03/26/2009)

DECISION AND ORDER terminating plaintiff Victoria. The application to proceed in forma pauperis is denied as moot. There being no remaining plaintiffs, the complaint is dismissed without prejudice and leave to appeal as a poor person is denied. Signed by Hon. David G. Larimer on 6/4/2010. (DLC) (Entered: 06/08/2010)

JUDGMENT terminating plaintiff Victoria. The application to proceed in forma pauperis is denied as moot. There being no remaining plaintiffs, the complaint is dismissed without prejudice and leave to appeal as a poor person is denied. Any appeal must be filed with this Clerk's Office, within 30 days of the date of this judgment. Signed by the Clerk of the Court on 6/8/2010. (DLC) (Entered: 06/08/2010)
